author: GH-Jaider

brief.en: Karel can only carry what he picks up, and the pile must cross the row one beeper at a time. Rebuild it on the far square and come home empty-handed.
brief.es: Karel sólo lleva lo que recoge, y la pila tiene que cruzar la fila de un zumbador en un zumbador. Recompónla en la esquina del fondo y vuelve con las manos vacías.

solution:
BEGINNING-OF-PROGRAM
    DEFINE-NEW-INSTRUCTION turnaround AS
    BEGIN
        turnleft;
        turnleft
    END
    BEGINNING-OF-EXECUTION
        WHILE next-to-a-beeper DO
        BEGIN
            pickbeeper;
            WHILE front-is-clear DO
                move;
            putbeeper;
            turnaround;
            WHILE front-is-clear DO
                move;
            turnaround
        END
        turnoff
    END-OF-EXECUTION
END-OF-PROGRAM
